title: Find a refCnt issue in HttpPostRequestEncoder.java when I run HttpUploadClient.java example on netty-netty-4.0.25.Final
body:
# Issue:

When I run HttpUploadClient.java example on netty-netty-4.0.25.Final, it works well.
But when I make a little change on textAreaLong parameter’s value which was sent in HttpUploadClient.java as below:
change from:

```
        bodyRequestEncoder.addBodyAttribute("fourthinfo", textAreaLong); 
```

to:

```
        bodyRequestEncoder.addBodyAttribute("fourthinfo", textAreaLong.substring(0, 7470));
```

I met below issue and the request couldn’t be sent successfully.

# Fixed Issue:

After debug the code, I found that this issue is because when I change the length of parameter’s value, it will call fillByteBuf method in HttpPostRequestEncoder.java, which there is a refCnt issue here.
When I change the code on fillByteBuf method in HttpPostRequestEncoder.java from:

```
        ByteBuf slice = currentBuffer.slice(currentBuffer.readerIndex(), HttpPostBodyUtil.chunkSize);
```

to:

```
        ByteBuf slice = currentBuffer.slice(currentBuffer.readerIndex(), HttpPostBodyUtil.chunkSize);
        currentBuffer.retain();
```

The above issue was fixed and works well.
